name: submit_forecast
description: Submit a calibrated probability estimate with dated evidence.

probability.description: Your probability that the stated outcome occurs.

reasoning_summary.description: At most 60 words. What drove the estimate.

published_at.description: ISO date, or null if the source is undated. Null is displayed as 'undated'. Do not guess a date.

risks.description: What would make this estimate wrong.

resolution_ambiguity.description: How clearly the resolution criteria determine an outcome.

insufficient_evidence.description: True if you could not find enough relevant dated sources to form an estimate. This is a correct and useful answer.
